extracted.PURPOSE: Adversarial re-test of the prior report's compounded-GLP-1 enforcement timeline. Two defects found. Both are index-vs-index and therefore themselves unverified, but they show the prior timeline is not the only reading of the same evidence.

DEFECT_A_LIKELY_DOUBLE_COUNTING.prior_report_claim: Treated the 30-letter action and the Weightless Medical LLC dba WeightCare letter (721478, dated 02/20/2026) as two independent enforcement data points, the latter offered as proof that 'enforcement continues into 2026'.
DEFECT_A_LIKELY_DOUBLE_COUNTING.what_the_index_now_indicates: The 30-letter wave itself is dated February 20, 2026 and was announced March 3, 2026. WeightCare's letter shares that exact 02/20/2026 date, so it is most plausibly one OF the 30 rather than a separate later action.
DEFECT_A_LIKELY_DOUBLE_COUNTING.status: UNVERIFIED both ways - the warning letter pages and the press announcement are all 403. Recorded as a competing reading, not as a corrected fact.

DEFECT_B_MISSED_MORE_RECENT_ENFORCEMENT_.finding: The index reports a further wave of warning letters published June 16, 2026 to approximately 25 companies over marketing of compounded GLP-1-style medications. The prior report's most recent enforcement item was Medica Weight Loss (728284) dated 06/08/2026, and it did not surface the June 16, 2026 wave at all.
DEFECT_B_MISSED_MORE_RECENT_ENFORCEMENT_.why_this_matters: The prior report listed as unresolved: 'Whether any FDA enforcement-discretion policy, guidance, or litigation-driven stay issued between May 2026 and 2026-07-30 ... CANNOT RULE OUT. The index's coverage of the most recent two months is unknown and unmeasurable.' That coverage gap is no longer hypothetical - it is demonstrated by an item the prior sweep missed.
DEFECT_B_MISSED_MORE_RECENT_ENFORCEMENT_.direction_of_effect: Reinforces exclusion. FDA enforcement against consumer-facing presentation of compounded GLP-1s is more recent and more active than the prior report established, not less.

ALSO_LOCATED_UNVERIFIED.2025_volume: Index reports FDA sent over 100 letters to telehealth and compounding providers over GLP-1 claims during 2025. The prior report located 8 individual letters dated 09/09/2025, which is consistent with a partial sample and is not a conflict.
ALSO_LOCATED_UNVERIFIED.new_quality_signal: Index reports a March 2026 study identifying a tirzepatide-B12 adduct in mass-compounded tirzepatide-with-B12 that is absent from FDA-approved tirzepatide. Secondary only; must not be published. Independently undercuts any assumption of stable product identity across compounded sellers.

extracted.enforcement_conduct_category_unchanged: The regulated conduct remains presentation and claims on consumer-facing sites, including implying sameness with FDA-approved products and obscuring sourcing. The prior report's NO_ADJACENCY conclusion is directionally supported, though its supporting FDA quotation remains unread and unquotable.
